hits.title: Safehire.ai Secures Latest Seed Investment for AI-Driven Dark Web Background Checks | Funding Spotter
hits.snippet: Safehire.ai Ltd, a London-based company specialising in AI-driven "human in the loop" (HITL) dark web background checks, has successfully secured a new seed funding round of £250k. The funding, allotted on April 20, 2026, and filed on April 29, 2026, marks another step in the company's growth trajectory since its incorporation in January 2024. ... This latest £250k seed round follows a pattern of strategic early-stage investments. The company previously raised £250k in a seed round on May 23, 2025, and another £250k seed round on April 4, 2025. Prior to these, Safehire.ai secured £50k in funding on December 10, 2024, at a valuation of £1.9m. This series of seed investments highlights a sustained commitment to developing and scaling its innovative background check solutions.

Safehire has secured a second seed investment round. We will use the investment to keep developing our Digital Risk Screening platform, strengthen our analyst capability and take the service into more high-trust sectors. Safehire started in safeguarding-sensitive organisations. We are now seeing demand from enterprise recruitment and workforce assurance teams facing a similar problem: formal checks do not always give them enough visibility before they grant access to vulnerable people, sensitive systems, data or regulated roles. DRS adds a structured digital review to existing checks. AI helps us search lawfully accessible surface, deep and dark web sources. Human analysts check identity, relevance and context before findings are reported. Thank you to our customers, partners, team and those supporting Safehire’s growth. Read the press release here: https://lnkd.

snippets.title: N24 | Teknoloji Girişimi 583 Bin Euro Yatırım Aldı
snippets.snippet: ı # Teknoloji Girişimi 583 Bin Euro Yatırım Aldı İngiltere merkezli Safehire.ai, yapay zeka destekli dijital risk tarama teknolojilerini geliştirmek için 583.2 bin Euro tutarında yatırım topladı. İngiltere merkezli dijital risk istihbarat şirketi Safehire.ai, kurumsal işe alım süreçlerinde güvenlik standartlarını yükseltmek amacıyla 583.2 bin Euro değerinde ek yatırım aldığını duyurdu. Eski ordu mensupları tarafından kurulan şirket, toplam yatırım miktarını 1.8 milyon Euro seviyesine taşıdı.
